text:
Research check, 21:37Z. There is no global chromatic result; no reviewed proof of any improvement exists.

Local Lean results:
- A6-Forcing-m1 PASSED (62.7 s). The finite Fin 6 forcing lemma is now machine-checked: forced labels f=(1,5,3,1,5,3), hits (345,123,015)x2 and adjacent disjointness give the canonical pairs f j, f j+3. There is no palette-cardinality premise. This is the first compiled piece of the formal A6 producer.
- StepBanShort FAILED at one point. `decide` cannot find `Decidable` for `five_pair_meet` because `fiveAdj` is an opaque `def` to instance search. A kernel `decide` over all Finset (Fin 5) pairs would also be costly. I sent the architecture coordinator a concrete fix: a 625-case label lemma `five_outsider_unique` with `fiveAdj` written out, plus a 6-line structured `five_pair_meet`. The `sorryAx` in the log comes only from that failed lemma.
- EvenWalk r1 failed (30 errors). The verifier coordinator has written revision 2 (SHA 3adb35ed…, LF, no sorry), which addresses every logged error. I am staging it with its manifest for my review. It will not be queued until reviewed.

Queued this cycle (1 of 2): A6-Bridge-m2 on the threecentre-r1 pin. I reviewed it as pure source, no sorry. If it passes, the bridge from the source restrictions to the a.e. canonical subpalette is checked, modulo the explicit SignTable/ForcingLemma/ArcCover hypotheses.

Not queued: G1-Sign-m2. The formal team found two real defects in it, so it would fail. It lacks the import for `direction_inner_real` (Interfaces.lean:196), and it uses `decide` with a free Fin 6 binder. Its accepted replacement, G1-Finish-mB.lean, is being downloaded for review. G1 is closed on paper; G3 ArcCover is still with m1 of smwgwui56.

Mathematics banked by the teams:
- All-phase relaxation is classified. A one-centre palette relaxation field exists iff some phase orbit carries a circulant sign matrix. The SAT set has measure exactly 1/648 (1440 of 933120 resonance cells, 120 cyclic orders x 12 circulant lifts). Three independent lanes agree on this.
- The only extra source relation, |palette| <= 3, is inert on the SAT cells.
- The fixed-phase census decides the problem only on the fully resonant stratum.
- The ⟹ direction of rigidity is verified on all 720 rooted orders but is not hand-proved. This is a relaxation result, not a colouring result.

Blockers:
1. The A5 sliver interval certificate is waiting on the closed-form definitions of u1, u3, s1, s3, sigma(theta3) and the second-parameter range. I have requested these from the verifier coordinator.
2. R1 acceptance gates (closure, contracts) remain with you.
3. The independent (smwgwz8na), formal (smwgwui56) and adversarial (smwgw48kc) swarms are running and healthy, so I did not message them.

Next actions:
- Review EvenWalk r2 and G1-Finish-mB, then queue them.
- Queue StepBanShort r2 when it arrives.
- Forward the A5 definitions to the parent for the interval check.
- Judge G3 ArcCover once m1 reports.
summary: Compiled: A6 finite forcing lemma (pass). Failed with diagnosed fixes: StepBanShort (Decidable on fiveAdj; fix sent) and EvenWalk r1 (r2 written, under review). Queued: A6-Bridge-m2. Relaxation classification: field exists iff circulant orbit; SAT measure 1/648 confirmed by three lanes; ⟹ direction verified on 720 orders, not hand-proved. A5 sliver is numerical only until its definitions arrive. No global chromatic improvement.
